nodes.name: .vercelignore
nodes.summary: Vercel deploy ignore list excluding tests, scripts, planning docs, and supabase migrations from production bundle uploads.

nodes.name: agent.py
nodes.summary: LiveKit-based voice agent entrypoint that wires the Assistant LLM, OpenAI TTS, Deepgram STT, and Silero VAD together for real-time spoken sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses async entrypoint pattern typical of LiveKit Python agents.

nodes.name: Assistant
nodes.summary: LiveKit Agent subclass holding the system instructions for the voice assistant persona.

nodes.name: entrypoint
nodes.summary: Async entrypoint that connects to the LiveKit room, instantiates the AgentSession with Deepgram STT / OpenAI LLM+TTS / Silero VAD, and greets the user.

nodes.name: AnimationShowcase.tsx.fixed
nodes.summary: Orphaned backup copy of an AnimationShowcase React component left at the repo root with the `.fixed` suffix; not part of the active build.

nodes.name: AnimationShowcase.tsx.temp
nodes.summary: Temporary scratch copy of the AnimationShowcase React component left at the repo root; not part of the active build.

nodes.name: check-real-progress.js
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc Supabase script that queries the most recent video_jobs row and prints its current stage / progress state to the console.

nodes.name: checkRealProgress
nodes.summary: Fetches the latest video_jobs record from Supabase and logs status, progress, and error fields for manual inspection.

nodes.name: check-subtitles.js
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc Supabase script that inspects the latest job's subtitle artifacts to verify caption generation worked.

nodes.name: checkSubtitles
nodes.summary: Reads subtitle-related columns from the most recent video job in Supabase and logs them for manual debugging.

nodes.name: check-video-urls.js
nodes.summary: Tiny diagnostic that lists video URLs from Supabase to sanity-check storage paths.

nodes.name: checkURLs
nodes.summary: Pulls video URL columns from Supabase and logs them, used to verify generated assets are reachable.

nodes.name: CleanCopy
nodes.summary: Stray extensionless file at the project root left behind by an interrupted command; not referenced by the build.

nodes.name: comprehensive-database-report.js
nodes.summary: Diagnostic script that probes the Supabase schema, analyzes viral-prediction workflow gaps, and prints recommendations for the database layout.

nodes.name: getExistingTables
nodes.summary: Returns the set of project tables that respond to a Supabase HEAD query, used to discover the live schema.

nodes.name: getTableDetails
nodes.summary: Fetches a sample row and column metadata for a single table to feed the comprehensive report.

nodes.name: analyzeWorkflowGaps
nodes.summary: Cross-references discovered tables against the expected viral-prediction workflow to flag missing or under-populated steps.

nodes.name: generateRecommendations
nodes.summary: Synthesizes prioritized DBA recommendations from the table set and workflow gap analysis.

nodes.name: generateComprehensiveReport
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator that introspects the schema, runs the gap analysis, prints a formatted report, and emits recommendations.

nodes.name: database-audit.js
nodes.summary: Older diagnostic that walks the Supabase schema, audits the viral-prediction workflow tables, and prints a long-form report.

nodes.name: getAllTables
nodes.summary: Probes a hardcoded list of expected tables and returns those that respond, building a snapshot of the live schema.

nodes.name: getTableInfo
nodes.summary: Gathers a single table's row count and a sample row for the audit report.

nodes.name: auditViralPredictionWorkflow
nodes.summary: Checks each step of the viral-prediction pipeline against the live schema and reports missing pieces.

nodes.name: checkDataFlow
nodes.summary: Traces a sample record through related tables to verify joins between scraped data, predictions, and outputs.

nodes.name: generateReport
nodes.summary: Prints the formatted audit report combining table inventory, workflow audit, and data-flow checks.

nodes.name: database-detailed-audit.js
nodes.summary: Deeper diagnostic that drills into scraped data, Apify runs, hook frameworks, and data quality to surface workflow gaps.

nodes.name: examineScrapedData
nodes.summary: Inspects the scraped_data table for shape, freshness, and platform coverage.

nodes.name: examineApifyRuns
nodes.summary: Reviews recent Apify run records to confirm scrapers are firing and saving results.

nodes.name: examineHookFrameworks
nodes.summary: Audits the hook_frameworks table content distribution to validate the viral hook taxonomy.

nodes.name: checkDataQuality
nodes.summary: Runs spot checks on null rates, duplicates, and join integrity across the prediction-related tables.

nodes.name: checkWorkflowGaps
nodes.summary: Identifies records that should have progressed to the next workflow stage but didn't, isolating pipeline stalls.

nodes.name: runDetailedAudit
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator that runs each examine/check helper in sequence and prints the combined detailed audit.

nodes.name: e HEAD
nodes.summary: Stray file created when a shell command (likely `git log --no-patc`e HEAD`) was mistyped at the repo root; not part of the build.

nodes.name: et GIT_PAGER=cat
nodes.summary: Large stray file created by a mistyped shell command (`s`et GIT_PAGER=cat ...`); captures truncated terminal output and is not part of the build.

nodes.name: firestore.rules
nodes.summary: Firestore security rules controlling read/write access to the project's Firestore collections.

nodes.name: full_codebase_snapshot.patch
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder for a full-codebase patch snapshot; carries no diff content.

nodes.name: get-pip.py
nodes.summary: Vendored copy of the upstream pip bootstrap installer used to install pip into a Python environment from a single self-contained script.
nodes.languageNotes: The bulk of the 28K-line file is a base85-encoded pip zipapp embedded in the script body.

nodes.name: include_setuptools
nodes.summary: Decides whether to install setuptools alongside pip based on the parsed installer arguments.

nodes.name: include_wheel
nodes.summary: Decides whether to install the wheel package alongside pip based on the parsed installer arguments.

nodes.name: determine_pip_install_arguments
nodes.summary: Builds the argv list passed to the embedded pip zipapp's install command, including conditional setuptools/wheel additions.

nodes.name: monkeypatch_for_cert
nodes.summary: Patches pip's HTTPS adapter to use the bundled CA cert bundle when running under older Pythons missing modern roots.

nodes.name: bootstrap
nodes.summary: Materializes the embedded pip zipapp on disk and invokes its install entry point with the determined arguments.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Script entry point that extracts the embedded zipapp into a temp dir, applies cert monkeypatch, and delegates to bootstrap.

nodes.name: h origin fixed-advanced-prediction
nodes.summary: Stray file created when a shell command (likely `git pus`h origin fixed-advanced-prediction`) was mistyped at the repo root; captures terminal output.

nodes.name: how v0.5.0-verified --no-patch --pretty=fuller
nodes.summary: Stray file created by a mistyped `git s`how ... command; captures terminal output and is not part of the build.

nodes.name: how v0.7.0-moat2 --decorate=full --no-patch
nodes.summary: Stray file created by a mistyped `git s`how ... command; captures a few lines of terminal output and is not part of the build.

nodes.name: jest.config.js
nodes.summary: Jest configuration for the project's unit-test suite, wiring transformers and module-name mappers for the Next.js codebase.

nodes.name: jest.rtl.config.js
nodes.summary: Secondary Jest configuration tuned for React Testing Library component tests with a JSDOM environment.

nodes.name: next.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Next.js App Router configuration controlling experimental flags, image domains, webpack tweaks, redirects, and build-time externals for the Trendzo platform.
nodes.languageNotes: ESM module config with conditional flags driven by environment variables.

nodes.name: package.json.backup
nodes.summary: Backup copy of a prior package.json kept at the repo root; not consumed by any build tool.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright end-to-end test configuration declaring the test directory, base URL, and browser projects.

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration enabling Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer for the Next.js build pipeline.
